name: Kolmogorov flow synthetic simulation dataset
size_as_stated: 8196 independent trajectories – each of length 64 and discarding the first half for warm-ups
access: Synthetic data is generated according to the script provided in https://github.com/juannat7/cohesion.

scales.note: Dimensionless 2D Kolmogorov flow simulation on [0, 2pi]^2 domain; physical dimensions in meters and seconds are not defined
